title: Photo of Haj Qasem Soleimani in Front of Netanyahu’s Eyes at the UN
text:
Photo of Haj Qasem Soleimani in Front of Netanyahu’s Eyes at the UN"

"Baqaei: During the inauspicious presence of the butcher of Gaza and the ill-wisher of Iran at the UN rostrum, most of those present left the hall as a sign of disgust at his foulness and malevolence."

"🔹 Before leaving the hall, the Iranian delegation left this image behind so that the reminder of the awe of our honored martyr, General Soleimani, would further unsettle the demon’s twisted mind and make the spider’s web of his ambitions appear more fragile than ever in his eyes.
